approach: In history.rs add `LandingKind` (snake_case enum: JobLanding, DeclaredIntervention, RecordsOnly), make `LandingCommit` carry a required `kind` and `Option<JobId>` job / `Option<RecordId>` verification with `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]`. Landing::validate enforces per kind: job_landing needs both, the others forbid both. Add HistoryError variants for the two failures. gh.rs `commits()` sets kind JobLanding with Some(job)/Some(verification); `intent()` (gh.rs ~1478) reads `commit.job` so it must handle Option; the ~3788 test constructor gets the new fields. Update history.rs tests. Add a CHANGELOG entry. manage.rs needs no code change (it only reads a different `history.commits` count, no LandingCommit use).

decisions.choice: Make job and verification Option with default + skip_serializing_if; missing kind stays an error because kind has no default.
decisions.reason: Non-job kinds must not claim a job; omitted-when-absent keeps JSON clean. Required kind means old records without kind are rejected, as requested.

rejected.option: Enum with data (tagged variants carrying job/verification)
rejected.why: Changes the JSON shape away from the requested flat `kind` field.

decisions.choice: Forbid both job and verification for the non-job kinds.
decisions.reason: Matches the accepted reading of 'must not claim a job'.

rejected.why: A verification without a job is meaningless for these kinds.

decisions.choice: New HistoryError variants (MissingForKind(&'static str), NotAllowedForKind(&'static str)).

rejected.why: Message 'must not be empty' misleads for forbidden fields.

decisions.choice: Leave pr_commits in land.rs untouched; gh.rs only wraps its output.

files.purpose: Add LandingKind, kind field, optional job/verification, validation, new error variants, tests.
commits() sets JobLanding with Some job/verification; intent() handles Option job; update test constructor ~3788.
Listed as a deliverable, but I found no use of LandingCommit there; edit only if the build shows a need.

steps: In history.rs add `LandingKind` (Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize; rename_all snake_case) with doc comments.
Change LandingCommit: add `kind: LandingKind`; job: Option<JobId>, verification: Option<RecordId>, each `#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]`; keep deny_unknown_fields.
Add two HistoryError variants and per-kind checks in the Landing::validate loop.

Update landing() test helper and add tests: each kind round-trips, unknown kind, missing kind, unknown field, job_landing without job/verification, non-job kinds with job/verification, omitted keys on serialize.
In gh.rs commits(): set kind JobLanding, job Some(c.job), verification Some(..); compute verification before moving c.job.
In gh.rs intent(): collect job_ids only from commits where `commit.job` is Some.
Update the test LandingCommit at ~3788 with kind and Some(..) values.
Run cargo test -p athena-data, cargo test -p athena-core gh, cargo clippy -p athena-data -p athena-core, cargo fmt --check.

risks.risk: Existing landing records on the records branch lack kind and will fail to parse.
risks.mitigation: The request makes kind required; the module docs say nothing reads or writes the branch in production yet.

risks.risk: Other code reads commit.job as non-Option and breaks compilation.
risks.mitigation: Grep showed only gh.rs ~1478; run cargo check -p athena-core -p athena-gate -p athena-cli.

demonstrations.method: Inspect source and a test that serializes non-job commits and checks the JSON.
demonstrations.observes: Test asserts serialized declared_intervention/records_only commits have no `job`/`verification` keys and kind serializes as snake_case strings; diff shows deny_unknown_fields retained and exactly three variants.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without Option+skip_serializing_if the key-absence assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Unit tests mutating landing() commits per kind and calling Landing::validate.
demonstrations.observes: job_landing missing job or verification -> Err; declared_intervention/records_only with job or verification -> Err; valid combos -> Ok.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without per-kind checks in Landing::validate the Err assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Round-trip each kind via HistoryRecord::parse(to_pretty_json); mutate JSON for unknown kind, removed kind, extra field in a commit.
demonstrations.observes: Each kind round-trips equal; the three malformed inputs return Err(Parse).
demonstrations.fails_without: Without a required closed enum, missing/unknown kind would parse.

demonstrations.method: Run gh tests including the landing test whose expected LandingCommit now has kind JobLanding, Some(job), Some(verification); git diff shows land.rs unchanged.
demonstrations.observes: Landing test passes comparing records built by commits() to the expected job_landing commit; land.rs not in diff.
demonstrations.fails_without: If commits() did not set JobLanding/job/verification the equality assertion at ~3787 fails.

demonstrations.observes: No warnings; then `cargo fmt --check` exits clean.
